context: Tests multi-resource generation: dependency order, consistent labels, selector agreement and a current Ingress API version.

checklist.name: Workloads and Services
checklist.description: Produces a Deployment and a Service for each of web and cache

checklist.name: ConfigMap first
checklist.description: The ConfigMap for nginx.conf appears before the Deployment that uses it

checklist.name: Current Ingress API
checklist.description: The Ingress uses networking.k8s.io/v1 and not extensions/v1beta1 or networking.k8s.io/v1beta1

checklist.name: Consistent labels
checklist.description: Uses the same app.kubernetes.io labelling scheme across all resources

checklist.name: Selectors match
checklist.description: Each Service selector matches its Deployment pod labels exactly

checklist.name: Pinned tags
checklist.description: Uses web:3.1.0 and redis:7.2.4 and not latest

checklist.name: Resources and probes
checklist.description: Sets resource requests and limits and health probes on both workloads

checklist.name: Explicit namespace
checklist.description: Sets a namespace on every namespace-scoped resource

checklist.name: Multi-document output
checklist.description: Combines the resources into multi-document YAML separated by ---

checklist.name: Validates each resource
checklist.description: Validates each resource and the combined set before delivery

checklist.name: Summary and next steps
checklist.description: Delivers a brief summary and next steps

checklist.name: Uses the target version
checklist.description: States or applies Kubernetes 1.27 when choosing API versions
